title: 第12章  这一趟不白来
slug: 人在镇魔司红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
吴守信脸色一变，噌的一下站了起来。
“二位，妖魔异动不容小觑，陈家之事暂且搁置。”
妖气乍现，意味着妖魔显露了踪迹，这种事情必须慎重以待，否则很可能会引发妖魔伤人事件。
至于陈家，目前只是怀疑，连证据都没有，孰轻孰重一目了然。
就在这时，一道声音突然响起。
“我去北渡口。”
就见陆渊面不改色地站了起来，眼底闪过一抹跃跃欲试的兴奋。
吴守信一愣，不是，那可是妖魔啊，你兴奋个什么劲？
他下意识皱起眉头，“小兄弟是新人吧？这里的妖魔可不比锁妖井，你还是——”
陆渊手上亮出腰牌，吴守信看去。
镇魔校尉！
他眼皮猛地一跳。
脚下一软。
“赤霞县镇魔卫吴守信，见过校尉大人！”
旁边的王书吏脸色剧变，连忙跟着拜了下去。
吴守信低垂着头，脸上火辣辣的，想起先前对陆渊的轻视，整个人就像是热锅上的蚂蚁。
“北渡口妖患我来处理。”陆渊语气平静，“你和老苏去陈家，趁着夜色探探虚实，切记不要打草惊蛇。”
“是！”吴守信领命。
苏定安张了张嘴，见此情景，话到嘴边又咽了回去。
一旁的衙役后退一步，抱拳拱手。

“校尉大人随我来，北渡口离驻所不远，两条街就到了......”
陆渊点头，快步向门外走去。
“陆大人！”
走到门槛时，身后突然传来苏定安的声音。
“妖魔凶残，万事小心。”
“放心。”
陆渊迈过门槛，大步走入夜色之中。
吴守信和王书吏这才站了起来，不禁露出一脸苦笑。
“苏大人，你也太不地道了，既是跟随校尉大人出行，进门时候好歹也给个表示啊？”
“好意思说我？”苏定安没好气道：“我这又眨眼又努嘴的，你是一点没看到啊。”
王书吏在旁边接了一嘴，“嗐，我是说这苏大人怎么口歪眼斜的......”
......
陆渊策马疾行，快得生风。
几名衙役跟在后面，跑得气喘吁吁，肺都快炸了，双腿直打颤。
“还有多远？”陆渊刻意放慢速度。
“快......快了，顺着这条街直走......到头就是北渡口......”领头的衙役上气不接下气道。
“行，你们歇会儿。”
说罢，陆渊一甩马鞭，胯下追风马嘶鸣，一眨眼便到了十丈开外。
几个呼吸后，他翻身下马，来到了渡口边上。
这里是赤霞县最大的渡口，白日里车船往来，入夜则是一片寂静，再往东就是通往青州的大河。

此刻的河面上漆黑一片，一排乌篷船泊在岸边，随波轻晃。
他目光一扫，妖气就是从那些船只中散出来的。
浓烈异常，绝对不止一只！
陆渊嘴角微微勾起，正愁不够杀呢。
太好了，是一群妖魔。
他正要抬脚，余光忽然瞥见一艘乌篷船的船板上好像蹲着个人影。
黑乎乎一团，缩在阴影里佝偻着背，浑身湿漉漉，像是刚从河里捞上来的。
陆渊看去，那东西正好看来。
四目相对，后者慢慢直起身，从船舱边上探出半个脑袋，眼瞳中绽放如腐蜡般的暗黄光芒。
此刻，陆渊看清了这东西的模样。
弓腰驼背，浑身上下长满黑毛，五官类猴，青面獠牙，一双眸子如冷黄磷火在黑暗中跳动。
它伸出指节分明的手掌，三寸长的利爪朝陆渊凌空一点。
陆渊眉头微皱。
什么意思？
这是把他当场猎物了？
陆渊顿时笑了。
眼下他已是初境，万化无极功也修至圆满，正愁没有妖魔练手。
结果遇到的第一只妖魔不跑也就算了，竟然还敢点他！
这能忍？
他踏前一步，抬手一指。

“别他妈瞎点了，老子就站这儿，有种你过来！”
话音落下，那只妖魔果然动了，但并没有冲过来。
而是抬头张嘴。
“唳！！！”
一声尖锐嘶鸣划破夜空，震得陆渊眉头紧皱。
下一刻，乌篷船里，浓烈的妖气冲天而起，一道道幽黄的瞳孔从黑暗中亮起，闪烁诡异光芒。
一只，两只，三只，四只......
一排乌篷船足足冒出八道身影，全是这种妖魔。
同时，水下传来动静。
他低头看去，河面上泛起涟漪，圈圈圆圆。
下面藏着黑影，至少二十多只。
陆渊站在原地，不着痕迹打量着四周。
妖魔在集结，越来越多，一只接一只从水下冒出。
有的趴在栈桥的木桩上，有的蹲在岸边的石块上，有的干脆站在水里只露出半截身子。
一双双幽黄眼瞳如夜色下的鬼火，密密麻麻，阴冷诡异。
陆渊忽然笑了。
笑得很大声，笑得那些妖魔都有些不明所以。
“好好好，赤霞县还真是好地方，先是血妖作乱，现在又冒出你们这些妖魔，老子这一趟还真是不白来。”
“话说，三十四只妖杀我一个人，你们杀得过来吗？”
那些妖魔看清了陆渊的表情，不是害怕，是兴奋。

领头的妖魔似是意识到不妙，忽然发出尖利嘶鸣。
三十四只妖魔一齐动了。
最近的那只从石块上跳起，四爪张开，三寸长的利爪闪着幽光，向陆渊扑杀而来。
陆渊周身气息汹涌，如渊似海。
万化无极功极速运转，掌心的灵力瞬间化晶，形成一道锋棱晶刺。
晶刺疾射而出，在尖锐的破空声中刺破空气。
以无坚不摧之势射爆妖魔头颅，随后去势不减，将一块丈许礁石打得四分五裂，这才消散一空。
碎石纷飞中，那只妖魔尸体栽在岸边，黑血白浆洒落一地。
【击杀凡境水伥，获得白色词条[夜瞳]】
剩余的水伥齐齐一顿，泛着黄光的瞳孔中闪过一抹迟疑之色。
船板上，领头的水伥发出尖细叫声，似是命令。
其它水伥互看一眼，同时动了。
它们从四面八方扑杀而来，攻势密集如雨，一瞬间封死了陆渊所有退路。
“这才像话。”
陆渊大喝一声，双手摊开，向上扬起。
浩瀚磅礴的灵力轰然涌出，在万化无极功的淬炼之下，一道道锋棱晶刺在他周身凝结。
月光洒下，晶刺在黑暗中划出璀璨流光，以无坚不摧之势射向四周。
噗噗噗噗——
惨叫声中，一只只水伥被接连打落。
有的胸口贯穿，有的头颅爆裂，有的断手断脚......

空气中弥漫起令人作呕的血腥味，不过十几息的功夫，地上便已经堆满妖尸。
【击杀凡境水伥，获得白色词条[夜瞳]×34】
领头那只水伥再也不敢停留，嘶吼一声转身就逃。
content_en:
Wu Shouxin's expression changed and he stood up suddenly.
"You two, the strange movements of demons should not be underestimated. The Chen family's affairs will be put on hold for now."
The sudden appearance of evil spirits means that the demon has revealed its traces. This kind of thing must be treated with caution, otherwise it may lead to incidents of demons hurting people.
As for the Chen family, it is just suspicion at the moment. There is no evidence. It is clear at a glance which one is more important.
At this moment, a voice suddenly sounded.
"I'm going to North Ferry."
Lu Yuan stood up without changing his expression, with a flash of excitement in his eyes.
Wu Shouxin was stunned, no, that was a demon. Why are you so excited?
He frowned subconsciously, "Little brother, are you new? The demons here are no better than Suo Yaojing, you still-"
Lu Yuan showed his waist card and Wu Shouxin looked at it.
The Demon-Suppressing Captain!
His eyelids twitched.
My feet felt weak.
"Wu Shouxin, the demon guard of Chixia County, has met the captain!"
The face of Secretary Wang next to him changed drastically, and he quickly followed and bowed down.
Wu Shouxin lowered his head, his face burning. Thinking of his previous contempt for Lu Yuan, he felt like an ant on a hot pot.
"I will deal with the demon problem in Beidukou." Lu Yuan said calmly, "You and Lao Su go to Chen's house and explore the truth under the cover of night. Remember not to alert the enemy."
"Yes!" Wu Shouxin accepted the order.
Su Ding'an opened his mouth, and when he saw this scene, he swallowed the words on his lips.
The officer on the side took a step back and cupped his fists.
"Master Colonel, come with me. Beidukou is not far from the station, just two streets away..."
Lu Yuan nodded and walked quickly out the door.
"Master Lu!"
When he reached the threshold, Su Ding'an's voice suddenly came from behind.
"The demon is cruel, so be careful."
"Don't worry."
Lu Yuan crossed the threshold and strode into the night.
Wu Shouxin and Secretary Wang stood up and couldn't help but smile bitterly.
"Mr. Su, you are too unreasonable. Since you are traveling with the captain, why don't you give me a sign when you come in?"
"Are you embarrassed to accuse me?" Su Ding'an said angrily: "You didn't notice me blinking and pouting."
Secretary Wang said next to him, "Hey, I mean, why is Mr. Su talking so crookedly..."
...
Lu Yuan rode his horse so fast that the wind blew.
Several government officials followed behind, running so breathless that their lungs almost exploded and their legs were shaking.
"How far is it?" Lu Yuan deliberately slowed down.
"Come on... hurry up, go straight along this street... at the end you will reach Beidakou..." the leading officer said out of breath.
"Okay, you guys take a break."
After that, Lu Yuan flicked his riding whip, and the wind-chasing horse neighed, and in the blink of an eye he was ten feet away.
After a few breaths, he dismounted and came to the edge of the ferry.
This is the largest ferry in Chixia County. During the day, cars and boats come and go, but at night it is silent. Further east is the big river leading to Qingzhou.
The river was pitch black at the moment, and a row of awning boats were moored on the shore, swaying gently with the waves.
He glanced around and saw that the evil spirit was emanating from those ships.
Extremely strong, definitely more than one!
The corners of Lu Yuan's mouth curled up slightly, worrying that he wasn't enough to kill him.
Great, they are a bunch of monsters.
He was about to lift his feet when he suddenly caught a glimpse of a figure squatting on the deck of a awning boat.
A dark mass, huddled in the shadows with a hunched back, wet all over, as if it had just been fished out of the river.
Lu Yuan looked around and saw that thing was just right.
Their eyes met, and the latter slowly straightened up and poked half of his head out from the side of the cabin, his pupils glowing with a dark yellow light like rotten wax.
At this moment, Lu Yuan saw clearly what this thing looked like.
He has a hunched back and is covered with black hair. He has monkey-like facial features, a green face and fangs, and a pair of eyes that dance in the darkness like cold yellow phosphorous fire.
It stretched out its palms with distinct knuckles, and its three-inch long sharp claws pointed towards the land.The abyss is a little higher in the air.
Lu Yuan frowned slightly.
What's the meaning?
Was he preying on him?
Lu Yuan suddenly laughed.
Now he is in the first stage and has perfected the Wanhua Wuji Kung Fu. He is worried that there are no demons to practice with him.
As a result, the first monster I met didn't care about running away, but he actually dared to click on him!
Can this be tolerated?
He took a step forward and raised his hand.
"Don't be so fucking blind. I'm standing right here. Come over if you dare!"
As soon as he finished speaking, the demon indeed moved, but it did not rush over.
Instead, he raised his head and opened his mouth.
"Bah!!!"
A sharp scream pierced the night sky, causing Lu Yuan to frown.
The next moment, in the awning boat, a strong demonic aura rose into the sky, and a series of faint yellow pupils lit up from the darkness, flashing strange light.
One, two, three, four...
Eight figures emerged from a row of awning boats, all of which were this kind of monster.
At the same time, there was movement under the water.
He looked down and saw ripples and circles on the river.
There were dark shadows hidden underneath, at least twenty of them.
Lu Yuan stood there, looking around without leaving any trace.
The demons were gathering, more and more, emerging from the water one after another.
Some were lying on the wooden piles of the trestle, some were squatting on the rocks on the shore, and some simply stood in the water with only half of their bodies exposed.
A pair of yellow eyes were like will-o'-the-wisps in the night, densely packed, cold and strange.
Lu Yuan suddenly smiled.
He laughed so loudly that the demons were confused.
"Okay, okay, Chixia County is really a good place. First the blood demon caused chaos, and now demons like you appear. My trip is really not in vain."
"By the way, if thirty-four demons kill me alone, can you kill them?"
Those monsters saw Lu Yuan's expression clearly, it was not fear, but excitement.
The leading demon seemed to realize that something was wrong, and suddenly let out a sharp scream.
Thirty-four demons moved together.
The nearest one jumped up from the stone, opened its four claws, and its three-inch long sharp claws flashed with light, and rushed towards Lu Yuan.
Lu Yuan's aura surged around his body, like a deep or sea.
The Wanhua Wuji Kung Fu operates extremely fast, and the spiritual power in the palm instantly crystallizes, forming a sharp crystal thorn.
The crystal thorns shot out quickly, piercing the air with a sharp sound.
He shot the demon's head with an invincible force, and then the force continued unabated, smashing a piece of reef into four pieces before dissipating.
Amidst the debris flying, the monster's corpse was planted on the shore, with black blood and white slurry spilling all over the ground.
[Kill the Mortal Realm Water Demon and obtain the white entry [Night Eye]]
The remaining dwarfs all paused, a look of hesitation flashing through their yellow-glowing pupils.
On the board of the boat, the leading mermaid made a shrill scream, which seemed to be an order.
The other water minions looked at each other and moved at the same time.
They attacked from all directions, and their attacks were as dense as rain, blocking all Lu Yuan's retreat routes in an instant.
"That's true."
Lu Yuan shouted loudly, spread his hands and raised them upward.
Vast and majestic spiritual power surged out, and under the tempering of the Wanhua Wuji Kung Fu, a series of sharp crystal thorns condensed around his body.
The moonlight shines down, and the crystal thorns draw bright streams of light in the darkness, shooting around with indestructible force.
Puff puff puff——
Amidst the screams, one after another the kelpies were knocked down one after another.
Some had their chests pierced, some had their heads exploded, some had their arms and legs severed...
The air was filled with the disgusting smell of blood, but within a dozen breaths, the ground was already covered with demon corpses.
[Kill the Mortal Realm Water Demon and obtain the white entry [Night Eye] × 34]
The leading water turtle didn't dare to stay any longer, turned around and ran away with a roar.
